bull.t: Strong revenue growth and enterprise expansion
bull.b: Rapid revenue growth combined with increasing enterprise adoption indicates Klaviyo is expanding beyond smaller customers and winning larger, more strategic accounts. That mix shift can support durable customer relationships, broader product usage, and a larger recurring revenue base over the next several quarters.

bull.t: Robust and growing free cash flow
bull.b: Strong operating and free cash flow gives Klaviyo substantial internal funding capacity for product development, infrastructure, acquisitions, and capital returns. The sustained shift from negative cash generation to growing positive cash production also improves resilience while the company continues scaling its platform.

Making Klaviyo accessible through leading AI systems and an extensive API and MCP layer broadens how customers can use its data and automation capabilities. This headless architecture can deepen platform integration, increase workflow relevance, and support adoption as AI-led marketing processes develop.

bear.b: Although Klaviyo generates substantial cash, very limited GAAP earnings show that the business has not yet converted scale into consistently strong bottom-line profitability. Results therefore remain sensitive to expense growth, investment levels, and any slowdown in customer demand or revenue expansion.

bear.t: Gross-margin pressure from text mix and carrier fees
bear.b: A rising contribution from text messaging and higher carrier fees are reducing gross-margin performance, while management expects additional near-term pressure. If text continues growing faster than other products, this mix effect could constrain operating leverage and the pace of profit improvement.

bear.t: Net revenue retention faces a profile-enforcement headwind
bear.b: Net revenue retention is a key indicator of expansion within the existing customer base, and the expected drag through Q1 may moderate recurring growth even as new customer acquisition remains strong. Slower expansion can reduce predictability and increase reliance on continued new-logo wins.
